analysis: {'Project A': {'Pros': ['• **Clear Value Proposition:** The concept of ethically sourced, cultivated leather is novel and addresses a growing consumer demand for sustainable and animal-friendly products.', '• **Feasibility & Development Plan:** The development plan, while early-stage, outlines clear milestones and a logical progression (cells isolated, prototypes, pilot testing).
